commits.message: feat(examples): effects-feel fade and dissolve carry a strip's fills with its words, from and to the terminal's ground (rich-effects-fxiy.b6i)

effects-feel: light only ever lights, so a glint on a dark fill reads as sun, not shadow (rich-effects-fxiy.b6i) (#314)

* feat(examples): effects-feel light catches a strip's lettering too, so a glint on a dark fill reads as light (rich-effects-fxiy.b6i)

On the strip's muted fills a glint could only deepen the fill to amber (light
text sits on them), which read as a passing shadow. A subject's lit colours
are now every colour its text cells set, each catching the side of a light
away from its partner (`catches`, `Side`): the lettering glints pale while the
fill glows amber, the way sunlight catches a sign. Label contrast holds at
rest under shimmer, pulse and sparkle; drift on dark improves 4.58 -> 4.90.

`Subject.slot` is gone: what a subject lights is what its text cells set. At
16 colours the theme's white is both a pale fill and lettering on a paler one,
so it has no side away from both and catches no light (an ANSI slot cannot
move anyway).

* feat(examples): effects-feel light only ever lights, so a glint on a dark fill reads as sun, not shadow (rich-effects-fxiy.b6i)

A darker colour was pulled toward a deep amber, which at a muted fill's
lightness is brown: a glint crossing the dark half of the strip read as a
shadow. Each light is now one colour; both colours of a cell move toward
it and never below their own lightness, the darker only 0.15 of the way,
so the fill warms a little while its lettering lifts to cream and the
worst contrast stays within 93% of rest. The status line is drawn at the
dimmest ink that still reads at 7:1, which leaves light room to lift it.

* feat(examples): effects-feel light takes each colour's share of what its cells can spare, so effects show (rich-effects-fxiy.b6i)

The loops sat at the threshold of seeing (pulse ~0.03 ΔE, drift 0.028)
because a fixed per-side share was the only thing keeping a glint from
closing a cell, and it closed some anyway: Latte's white-lettered fills fell
below AA, and its status line fell 7 -> 5.4.

A loop is now a Touch (what it does to a colour at a strength) and a Field
(how strongly, where and when). `shares` settles each colour, lightest first,
at the largest share every cell it is drawn in can take while still reading at
its resting contrast or WCAG AA, whichever is lower — measured on the colours
the run's depth draws, with strengths snapped to the levels checked. That
replaces Side/SHARE/catches and the "darker wins" fold.

Defaults retuned for visibility inside the 1 fps no-jump gate: shimmer 90 s
across a 32-column band, pulse 16 s at 0.29, drift 50 s at 24 degrees with a
stronger silver, sparkle 36 s at 0.6 with 6-column halos.

The status line's ink is `ensureContrast` of the muted ink at the run's depth
instead of a hand-rolled bisection.

* perf(examples): effects-feel builds each loop's effect once per subject, not per frame (rich-effects-fxiy.b6i)
